title: Alum precipitation of phosphorus
applicability: Chemical precipitation of phosphorous by Ferric or Aluminium salts: for each kg of phosphorous 0.9 kg of Aluminium or 1.8 kg of Iron is needed, so sludge production is less by half with Aluminium.
notes: Printed with the coefficient 2 of H₃PO₄ set as a subscript ("+ ₂H₃PO₄") and with no space before the plus sign; preserved as printed, not corrected.
All species are printed with closed-up subscripts (Al2(SO4)3, 18H2O, 2AlPO4, 3H2SO4); the readable form uses the same digits without subscript markup.
The middle dot is printed as a raised dot between the hydrate and the formula.
